description.text: Civil Engineering is a discipline centered on the construction of various types of infrastructure and architectural projects, covering the entire process including planning, design, construction, operation and maintenance. Its research objects include building construction, Bridges, roads, tunnels, water conservancy projects, underground projects, etc., aiming to solve the spatial needs for human survival and development through engineering technology. This major integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as mathematics, mechanics, materials science, and computer technology, aiming to cultivate compound talents with engineering practice ability and innovative thinking, and to meet the national strategic demands such as urbanization, transportation construction, and disaster prevention and mitigation.

duration.text: The Civil engineering at Shenyang Agricultural University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. One original copy and one photocopy of Application Form of Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students (see the attachment)2. Notarized certificate of highest degree and transcripts. A certificate of enrollment or a certificate of employment should also be submitted if applicants have been officially employed for a job. Documents that are formulated neither in Chinese of English should be enclosed with a notarized Chinese or English version upon submission.3. One original copy and photocopy of Foreigners Physical Examination Report4. Study and Research Plan in China (no less than 1000 words)5. Recommendation letters from 2 professors or associate professors of the previous school.
